label: Remote OK
terms_note: Free keyless API conditioned on a follow link back + naming Remote OK as source; logo is trademarked.

auth: 1. No account needed for the public feed; the tenant applies on the posting's own application page (assist card).

endpoints.notes: slug, id, epoch, date, company, company_logo, position, tags[], description (HTML), url, salary_min/max

reference.limits: - API ToS (in-payload): link back with a FOLLOW link to the Remote OK URL and name Remote OK as source, or access is suspended; no logo use. - robots.txt carries Content-Signal directives.

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit is published; the feed's in-payload terms only ask for attribution. Kept to one request every two seconds because a single call returns the whole board.
adapter.terms: Element 0 of the feed carries the API Terms of Service: 'Please link back (with follow, and without nofollow!) to the URL on Remote OK and mention Remote OK as a source, so we get traffic back from your site. If you do not we'll have to suspend API access. Please don't use the Remote OK logo without written permission as it's a registered trademark, please DO use our name Remote OK though.' (https://remoteok.com/api, opened 2026-09-24).

search_postings.note: Single keyless JSON array with no documented query, page or limit parameters: `query`, `category`, `min_budget`, `page` and `limit` are not sent and the whole feed (a few hundred rows) is returned; filter client-side. Element 0 of the feed is the legal notice (id null) and is dropped by the runtime (`require: [id]`). Fields per the feed: slug, id, epoch, date, company, company_logo, position, tags[], description (HTML), location, apply_url, salary_min, salary_max, url; currency is not stated. Attribution: link back (follow) to the Remote OK URL and name Remote OK as the source.

not_offered.submit_bid: Page: 'no proposal / message / contract surface exists on this venue' — applicants use the posting's own application page (apply_url).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: No per-id endpoint is documented; re-read the record from the search hit (`url` / `apply_url`).

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
